paper_title: Модели за проследяване на публикационната активност на изследователи
caption: Вход в информационната система
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the entry points into an information system, comparing various categories and their corresponding frequencies. The horizontal axis lists the categories, which are grouped into three sections: "Въвеждане и обработка в БД" (Introduction and processing in the database), "Честота на актуализиране на информацията:" (Frequency of updating information), and "Начин на набавяне на източниците на информацията за включване в цитатния указател:" (Method of obtaining information sources for inclusion in the citation index), while the vertical axis represents the frequency or count of each category, ranging from 0 to 11. The categories on the horizontal axis are listed in a specific order corresponding to their respective sections, with no apparent alphabetical or numerical sorting within the sections, and are labeled with descriptive text in Bulgarian; the vertical axis is labeled implicitly by the numbers on the axis, ranging from 0 to 11, with an interval of a single unit between each marked value, starting from 0 at the bottom and going up to 11 at the top. The bars in the chart vary in height, with the highest bar corresponding to "ретроспективно" (retrospective) with a frequency of 11, and several categories having a frequency of 0, including "друго" (other), "абонамент на периодика" (subscription to periodicals), "покупка" (purchase), "национален депозит" (national deposit), "институционален депозит" (institutional deposit), "дарение от авторите, чиято цитатна активност се следи" (donation from authors whose citation activity is tracked), and "ресурси, достъпни чрез социални научни мрежи: Mendeley, ResearchGate, Academia.edu, други (посочете кои)" (resources available through social scientific networks); the chart also shows that "текущо" (current) has a frequency of 6, and "друго (посочете какво)" (other, specify what) appears twice with frequencies of 3 and 6.
